title: Your Game Collection Is About to Vanish. Here's Why Sony's All-Digital Future Is a Disaster.
angle: We're arguing that Sony's move away from physical media isn't just an inconvenience, it's a fundamental attack on consumer ownership and game preservation that sets a dangerous precedent for all digital media.
rationale: This story taps into a passionate debate with a clear 'so what for me' angle, leveraging a top-rated story to drive high engagement and comments.

source_articles.title: PlayStation just struck a hammer blow to game preservation
source_articles.excerpt: Killing game discs is an anti-consumer move that only benefits Sony.

source_articles.title: Engadget Podcast: Who needs Valve's Steam Machine?
source_articles.excerpt: This week on the Engadget Podcast, we've got our first impressions of Valve's pricey Steam Machine, and we chat about Sony dumping PlayStation discs in 2028.
